raw_response:
I am 60 years old and have worked these 7 mu in Quzhou County for 40 years. I finished middle school. I do not read research papers — I learn from doing, from the input dealer in town, and from watching my neighbors.

My main field is 4 mu of wheat-maize double cropping. That is my base. Last year I got about 450 jin of wheat per mu. This year I will plant the improved wheat variety, buying 25 jin of seed per mu from the dealer I trust. In October I will rotary till and spread 100 jin of compound fertilizer per mu as base. At green-up in March I will top-dress 30 jin of urea per mu, and at jointing in April another 30 jin. That is about 25 kg of nitrogen per mu total. I know it is a lot, but two years ago Lao Wang cut his nitrogen back and his wheat turned yellow and thin. I cannot risk that. A bad harvest means my grandson's school fees are in trouble; wasting a bag of urea is just 110 yuan. I will irrigate 4 times: the winter water before freeze-up, then green-up, jointing, and grain filling. I spray herbicide once after sowing and fungicide twice in spring. I expect 480 kg per mu.

Right after combining wheat in early June, I sow hybrid maize on the same 4 mu. No-tillage — I sow directly into the wheat stubble. I put 80 jin of compound fertilizer per mu in the furrow at sowing. At big flare stage I side-dress 40 jin of urea per mu. Total nitrogen is about 22 kg per mu. I irrigate twice from my well — once when the tassels are coming out and once at grain filling. If July is very dry I might add a third, but usually twice is enough. I spray herbicide once and insecticide twice for corn borer. Last year I got 550 kg per mu and I will do the same.

I keep 1.5 mu for watermelon. It pays better than grain but the price jumps around. I plough that plot deep in April because watermelon roots need loose soil. I use hybrid seeds with plastic mulch — 50 yuan for the packet. Base dressing is 2 cartloads of rotted chicken manure per mu plus 60 jin of compound fertilizer. When the vines start running I add 30 jin of potassium sulfate per mu — the dealer said K makes the flesh sweet. Total N is about 18 kg per mu, P about 10 kg, K about 15 kg. I irrigate 5 times, small amounts each time, more when the fruits are swelling. I spray fungicide 3 times and insecticide twice. If the weather holds I expect 3500 kg per mu.

The other 1.5 mu is Bt hybrid cotton. I rotary till in late April and put 80 jin of compound fertilizer per mu as base. I top-dress urea twice: 20 jin at budding and 20 jin at first flower. Total N about 16 kg per mu, P about 8 kg, K about 10 kg. Cotton does not drink like wheat. I irrigate 3 times: at budding, flowering, and boll stage. Even with Bt seed I spray 3 times for aphids and red spider mite. Expected yield is 350 kg of seed cotton per mu.

My son works in a factory in Handan and sends home 2000 yuan a month, but the farm still has to pay for itself. I keep a notebook. Fertilizer for the whole farm will cost me about 2200 yuan this year. I would rather spend 200 yuan extra on urea than lose one mu of yield. When I am unsure, I do what I did last year, and I watch Lao Zhang across the road. If he is putting 60 jin of urea on his maize, I put 60 jin too.
